title: Add support bundle export command and view
purpose: Allow operators to inspect and export support bundle evidence from the TUI without leaking raw secrets.
scope: Add typed TUI command for support bundle status and export.
Render bundle inventory, included evidence hashes and redaction status.
Use existing support bundle generation logic.
Write export result into TUI evidence output.
Display failures for missing paths or redaction violations.
acceptance_criteria: TUI support export delegates to existing support bundle code.
Bundle view includes runtime, audit, ecosystem, update and safety sections.
Raw secrets are rejected or redacted before export.
Export command is available in scripted replay.
failure_modes: TUI implements a separate bundle format.
Support view omits ecosystem or active artifact state.
